Simulate data with gamma distributed error

Source: R/RcppExports.R
sim_gamma_data.Rd

Simulate data with gamma distributed error

Usage

sim_gamma_data(temp, n_reps, obs_cv, ctmin, ctmax, a, b, scale_tpc = FALSE)

Arguments

temp

Numeric vector giving the observed temperatures for each performance value.

n_reps

Single integer for the number of experimental reps per temperature.

obs_cv

Single numeric for the observation error coefficient of variation. Must be >= 0. Observation error is simulated using a gamma distribution with mean equal to the expected performance. Where expected performance is zero (temperatures at or outside ctmin and ctmax, or a = 0), the simulated value is 0.

ctmin

Single numeric for parameter ctmin.

ctmax

Single numeric for parameter ctmax.

a

Single numeric for parameter a.

b

Single numeric for parameter b.

scale_tpc

Single logical for whether to scale to make max value 1. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A dataframe of temperatures (column "temp") and performance values (column "y") with gamma error.

Examples

set.seed(1)
sim_gamma_data(temp = seq(10, 35, 5), n_reps = 3, obs_cv = 0.1,
               ctmin = 8, ctmax = 38, a = 1, b = 0.2)
#>    temp          y
#> 1    10   35.57286
#> 2    10   40.37871
#> 3    10   32.99959
#> 4    15  205.26965
#> 5    15  210.34050
#> 6    15  207.04828
#> 7    20  412.75265
#> 8    20  392.27028
#> 9    20  399.58658
#> 10   25  685.29039
#> 11   25  703.14054
#> 12   25  644.57431
#> 13   30 1079.00482
#> 14   30 1055.51676
#> 15   30 1089.18505
#> 16   35 1264.97387
#> 17   35 1180.10196
#> 18   35  949.37339
